title: Across the left digit
hook: Two stated cases: explore equal cash gaps with unequal integer-part changes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How equal cash gaps with unequal integer-part changes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines CashGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare equal cash gaps with unequal integer-part changes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
